cards.title: Separate Procedure
cards.summary: CPT 29870 is generally not separately payable in this clinical context. Payable estimate adjusted accordingly.
cards.text: Separate ProcedureCPT 29870 is generally not separately payable in this clinical context. Payable estimate adjusted accordingly.Learn More ▾⚠️ CPT 29870 is a separate-procedure diagnostic knee arthroscopy code. When diagnostic knee arthroscopy is performed in the same knee and same encounter as a definitive surgical knee arthroscopy, it is generally not separately payable. If the diagnostic arthroscopy was performed on the contralateral knee, at a separate encounter/session, or for a clinically independent diagnostic indication, separate reporting may be supportable with documentation.CPT 29870 is integral to CPT 29881 in this separate-procedure relationship. Selected/performed line is visible but excluded from payable estimate.Separate-procedure codes may be separately reportable only when performed at a distinct encounter, distinct anatomic site, or for a clinically independent indication supported by documentation.Modifier use should not bypass a same-incision or same-clinical-context separate-procedure relationship unless payer policy and documentation clearly support distinct work.If documentation shows substantially increased work on CPT 29881, review whether modifier 22 is supportable. Do not use modifier 22 to make the separate-procedure code payable.
